China Radio International FAQ

What frequency is China Radio International on?
In the B-26 season China Radio International is scheduled on 237 shortwave frequencies, including 5050, 5955, 5965, 5970, 5975, 5980 kHz. Best evening option for eastern North America: 9790 kHz (10 pm – 11 pm Eastern). For Europe: 9600 kHz (9 pm – 10 pm UTC+1).

What time is China Radio International on shortwave?
China Radio International is scheduled in 71 UTC time windows this season, from 00:00–01:00 UTC through 23:30–00:30 UTC. English broadcasts: 10:00–11:00 UTC; 11:00–13:00 UTC; 13:00–14:00 UTC; 14:00–15:00 UTC. All times are UTC; subtract your UTC offset for local time.

Can I hear China Radio International in the USA?
Yes. China Radio International is beamed at North America this season on 6180, 9570, 9790 kHz; the best evening option for eastern North America is 9790 kHz (10 pm – 11 pm Eastern).

Does China Radio International broadcast in English on shortwave?
Yes. English broadcasts this season: 5955 kHz at 10:00–11:00 UTC to Far East; 5955 kHz at 11:00–13:00 UTC to Far East; 5955 kHz at 13:00–14:00 UTC to Far East; 5955 kHz at 14:00–15:00 UTC to Far East; 5955 kHz at 15:00–16:00 UTC to Far East; plus 163 more.

Is China Radio International on the air right now?
As of Monday, November 9, 2026, 13:53 UTC, China Radio International is scheduled to be broadcasting on 5955 kHz to Far East. This is based on the published schedule at the time this page was built; check the live search for up-to-the-minute status.
